title: Test whether fresh workers abandon disproven narratives
body: Operator selected measurements of existing KRN mechanisms, not adoption based on research alone. Source: .krn/runs/rss-research/reports/Mechaniki zwiększające skuteczność KRN.md. All proposed effects remain unmeasured in KRN. No external service, production, credential or global policy mutation is granted by this task. Pre-register the bounded pilot and independent oracle before running it.

Outcome: measure narrative reset in bounded KRN cases rather than assuming Fork-and-Flush results transfer.
Prepare independently verified cases containing a disproven hypothesis, a current contract, observations and the best verified artifact. Compare a continuing worker with a fresh worker given only the valid packet, using equal budgets and the same real receiver oracle. Measure repeated disproven claims, correct continuation, retained constraints/authority, time and total cost. Reset must not discard valid grants, restrictions or unresolved acceptance. Pin sources and pre-register criteria before the trial. Use existing tasks/captures; do not add a memory platform or rewrite global workflow on a hypothesis.
